barriers.reason: Patient cannot miss work; two unexcused absences allowed before termination

alternatives.text: Ask the unit to move her chair time to after 3 PM on a Tuesday when she can stay after her shift, if slots are available.
Schedule the prenatal visit on a day she already travels to the hospital for another appointment (e.g., combine with the glucose test later that day).
Use Medicaid Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (MEDICARE_NEMT) to arrange a ride after her shift, confirming advance‑booking rules with her MCO.

barriers.reason: Saturday morning rides may not be available via bus or Medicaid transport after shift work

alternatives.text: Use Medicaid Non-Emergency Medical Transportation for a Saturday morning slot, if her MCO offers weekend service.
Request a Saturday session at a different satellite location that aligns with her husband’s drop‑off schedule.
Pair the Saturday class with another recurring hospital visit (e.g., the glucose test) to reduce separate travel.

barriers.reason: Her work shift ends at 2:30 PM and she relies on bus/ride, limiting time to shop for iron‑rich foods

alternatives.text: Utilize the Greater Chicago Food Depository’s weekday pantry open after 3 PM on Wednesdays.
Check whether her Medicaid MCO offers a medically‑tailored meals benefit for renal‑friendly iron‑rich foods.
Adjust prenatal visit timing to later in the day when she can attend a nutrition counseling session at the clinic.
